# WeOne

> WeOne is a web design, development and UI/UX agency based in Kolkata, India. We build websites, e-commerce stores (Shopify, WooCommerce, Wix), brand identities, and provide digital marketing and business consultancy for small and mid-sized businesses, primarily in India.

WeOne is a small, senior team — no account managers, no junior handoffs. We work directly with clients from strategy through design, development and launch.

## Services

- UI/UX Design — interface design, user research, and conversion-focused design systems.
- Web Development — custom-built and WordPress websites, responsive by default.
- E-commerce Development — Shopify, WooCommerce, and Wix stores, including payment integration and product catalog setup.
- Logo & Branding — brand identity, logo design, and visual systems.
- Digital Marketing — SEO and online visibility work alongside the websites we build.
- Business Consultancy — platform and technology strategy for founders deciding how to build or rebuild their online presence.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://weone.tech/): overview of services, portfolio highlights, client reviews, and frequently asked questions.
- [About](https://weone.tech/about): the WeOne story, team, and what the studio values.
- [Our Work](https://weone.tech/work): portfolio of past projects across e-commerce, SaaS, and brand design.
- [Pricing](https://weone.tech/pricing): website plans and pricing — one-time builds from ₹10,000, or monthly plans from ₹1,599/mo, including a frequently-asked-questions section.
- [Blog](https://weone.tech/blog): articles on web design, UX, e-commerce platform choice, and website performance.

- [How Website Speed Affects Conversion Rate](https://weone.tech/blog-detail-website-speed-conversion): the business cost of a slow website.
- [Ordinary Website vs Designed Website](https://weone.tech/blog-detail-ordinary-vs-designed-website): why structure, not decoration, is what separates the two.
